Travel to the beautiful Sand Hollow State Park and other riding trails in St George and Hurricane, Utah! Schedule OHV machines from our new fleet of Can-Am Maverick side by sides. We have two, four, five, and six-seater models with turbo models available. We provide the newest ATV’s - UTV’s models on the market, free helmets and goggles, free basic cleaning, full roofs for shade on all our UTV’s.
